`breaking-identity-labels` is an independently implemented local candidate.
Its Problem Spec, four initial baseline cases and ten-part deconstruction
contract were established before reviewing dontbesilent dbskill.

After the project owner confirmed noncommercial use, the implementation
reviewed dontbesilent dbskill at fixed revision
`8282f010964601070334dd7350973386abff6d2b` under CC BY-NC 4.0. The limited

- return broad labels to concrete use and observable facts;

No upstream commercial case, test, script, template wording, title library,

Full file-level provenance, exclusions and research boundaries are recorded in
